d: Wood on the beach of the sea adjacent to the casino of Atar. Atar silent, Aspasia.
The above, Fiammetta, Slaves of the seraglio, Aspasia, covered with a black veil.
Square with view of the temple of Brama. Axur, Arteneo.
Arteneus, Axur, then Elamir, Priests, etc.
The above, Axur, Altamor, Arteneo, Grandi dell'impero, Popolo, etc.
Lighted garden. Slaves in progress to finish the lighting. Bischoma, then Axur.
The above: two slaves and a slave dressed with the famous masks of Harlequin, Brighella and Smeraldina, sing the trio that follows.
Aspasia apartment. Fiammetta, Aspasia in great mess.
The above, Bischoma and chorus of Schiavi, Urson and choir of Soldiers, all outside.
Reggia. At the bottom view of the city. Axur alone; then Slaves and Guards.
Axur, Atar, chained between the Guards and Urson.
The above. Aspasia covered with a black veil, Fiammetta, Schiavi and Schiava etc.
Bischoma with skiable unlined in hand, followed by armed soldiers, and People.
All except Arteneus, Bismroma, and Urson on their knees want to get the irons out of Atar; he opposes it.
